messages:
sara_cs: Quick weekly for Orchid Labs. p95/p99 split on 'compose_stream' route. Streaming tail >> sync. Need fast mitigation before renewal touchpoint.
ben_se: looking — compose_stream / redwood-open-8k streaming p99 ~1.5s, sync p99 ~750ms. Baseline usage up, spend normal.
tomo_sre: can you share a short trace and KV miss numbers?
ben_se: trace snippet: `queue 14ms -> kernel 52ms -> kv_load 130ms -> decode 22ms` 
ben_se: telemetry quick: streaming p95 520ms -> 620ms; p99 1500ms -> 1480ms after a small prefix cache canary.
nia_onboard: Orchid PM said they use many tiny streaming chunks for instant-suggests. They can try merging chunks client-side.
sara_cs: Risk: Medium. Actions and owners?
ben_se: short-term: enable client prefix_cache + bump streaming workers by 1 node. I'll run canary.
tomo_sre: long-term: reduce KV miss rate, refine cache keys, consider quantized kernel path. I'll open follow-up ticket.
opsbot: Canary ready. Use `/deploy canary orchid-compose-cache` to start.
ben_se: applying canary now. Will watch p95/p99 for 45m.
opsbot: Canary launched -> orchid-compose-cache -> node-5
ben_se: 20m update: streaming p99 dropped 1.5s -> 0.92s, kv_miss_pct down ~24%. p95 modest improvement.
sara_cs: good. Nia, coordinate with Orchid PM on a 48h A/B for chunk merging.
nia_onboard: on it, PM agreed to test and will send prompt samples.
tomo_sre: telemetry snippet (minute): `09:40, kv_miss_pct:3.4, p95_stream_ms: 510, p99_stream_ms: 920`
sara_cs: Action list: ben_se (canary + final numbers), tomo_sre (KV analysis + ticket), nia_onboard (A/B + prompts), sara_cs (update renewal notes).
opsbot: Thread will be archived after 7 days of inactivity.
